phenotype.definition: Head or face pain on some days or more in the past 3 months (PAIHDFC3M_A 2-4; 'never had any pain' counts as no) AND at least one of: dizziness or balance problems in the past 12 months (BALDIZZ_A), any hearing difficulty even with a hearing aid (HEARINGDF_A 2-4), or tinnitus in the past 12 months (HRTINNITUS_A). Adults 40+ only; complete cases only. The proposal 7.1 phenotype narrowed to what NHIS 2023 can express: no sinonasal arm and no recalcitrance (utilization) arm.

eligibility.reason: Comparator for the NHANES 1999-2004 artifacts, whose balance questionnaire covered adults 40 and over. Same age floor, same otologic arms, different headache item and survey mode, so the comparison is indicative, not like-for-like.

questionText.headache_migraine: PAIHDFC3M_A, NHIS pain module (odd years), pain-location item for head or face ('HDFC'), 'how often in the past 3 months': 1 never, 2 some days, 3 most days, 4 every day. Positive = some days or more. Asked only of adults reporting any pain in the past 3 months (PAIFRQ3M_A = 2-4); a 'never' at that gate counts as no. Broader than NHANES MPQ090 'severe headaches or migraines': this item has no severity qualifier, so prevalence is not comparable to NHANES without the sensitivity run described in the map note.
questionText.dizziness_balance: BALDIZZ_A, 2023 rotating hearing and balance content, dizziness or balance problem in the past 12 months: 1 yes, 2 no. Asked of all adults; follow-ups BALDPROB_A (how much of a problem) and BALDHP_A (saw a health professional) asked only of 'yes'. 1,093 adults are 'not ascertained' (8) on this and the tinnitus item together; they stay missing.
questionText.hearing_difficulty: HEARINGDF_A, Washington Group short set, 'difficulty hearing, even when using a hearing aid': 1 no difficulty, 2 some difficulty, 3 a lot of difficulty, 4 cannot do at all. Positive = some difficulty or more. Asked of all adults every year.
questionText.tinnitus: HRTINNITUS_A, 2023 rotating hearing content, ringing, roaring or buzzing in the ears in the past 12 months: 1 yes, 2 no. Asked of all adults; follow-ups HRTINPROB_A and HRTINLNG_A asked only of 'yes'.

caveats: Screening-level phenotype prevalence, not diagnosed prevalence. No vestibular-testing or ICHD/Barany reference standard exists in these data.
Self-reported survey items; coding inconsistency may bias phenotype capture.
Hypothesis-generating estimate, not a diagnostic count.
Respondents coded Refused / Not Ascertained / Don't Know on a phenotype item are excluded from the denominator, never counted as negative.
Complete-case phenotype: a respondent missing any item the rule uses is excluded from the denominator.

Estimated within the eligible subpopulation only (AGEP_A >= 40): Comparator for the NHANES 1999-2004 artifacts, whose balance questionnaire covered adults 40 and over. Same age floor, same otologic arms, different headache item and survey mode, so the comparison is indicative, not like-for-like..
Concepts this cycle could not express: sinus_condition, recalcitrance_proxy. The phenotype reported here is narrower than the one defined in proposal 7.1.
No gender-identity item in this cycle: estimates are stratified by sex only. Gender is not substituted from sex.
